content.question: Match common association algorithms with their approaches.

answer.Apriori: It uses breadth-first search, expanding 1-itemsets to 2-itemsets, 3-itemsets and so on while pruning candidates below the minimum support threshold.
answer.Eclat: It uses depth-first search, generally faster when the dataset is dense and the TID lists are manageable.
answer.FP-Growth: It compresses the dataset into a compact tree and mines frequent itemsets directly from it, avoiding candidate generation entirely.
